utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the third of August. Can you all hear me? Right, let's get through the stand-up.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Just about. I'm still grieving over the broken coffee machine in the canteen.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: The broken coffee machine in the canteen has definitely improved my water intake. Not my mood, mind.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: That explains the atmosphere. Thought it was my headset.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Ha. Coffee complaints duly heard, not going on the job list. Completions first?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah so, I already swapped the filter on the Line 1 Hydraulic Power Unit yesterday. That's done.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: That's the one still showing on the old list, is it?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, same one. Not a second filter job.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And we finished the repair on the turbine two last night. That's a completion as well.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. Both closed, then.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: While I'm on, I noticed the boiler feed pump was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Settled back down on its own?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah. Just an observation, not raising another job out of it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. Worth mentioning, but nothing new agreed there.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And I can't get to the Main Outfeed Conveyor until production gives us a window. Still blocked.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: No window at all, then? Sorry, you clipped out for a second.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: No, nothing available. It's not work we can take on today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Same position here: can't get to the compressor one until production gives us a window. That stays blocked too.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And the shutdown on the Compressed Air Dryer is cancelled now, production need it running.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Ah, cancelled rather than just waiting for access?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Exactly. Off altogether, not another one sitting behind a production window.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, no shutdown work on that, then. Let's get onto what we are agreeing.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Grace, can you do a site visit at the water works with the contractor? No rush on that.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, just the site visit with them, rather than any work while we're there?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's it, Grace. The site visit at the water works with the contractor. No rush.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Fine, I'll do that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers. Um, toolbox talk next.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Han, can you organise the toolbox talk for the team? Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah. Not being bumped up above everything else, then?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No, normal priority on that one.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Okay, I'll organise the toolbox talk for the team.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: While you're there, where are we with spare parts for the Line 2 Pick and Place Robot?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I'll order spare parts for the Line 2 Pick and Place Robot today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks. Hannah Price against that one, ordering today.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yep, that's mine.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Sorry, I was trying to unmute and hit the hand thing. Nothing to add. Very professional.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Better than hanging up, which I've done. Right, the handover report.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Jamie, can you send the shift handover report round on Friday? Low priority.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: On Friday, yeah? Not asking for it round today?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's right, on Friday. It's low priority.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep, I'll send the shift handover report round on Friday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. Anything on the mechanical side?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll investigate the pressure drop on the booster pump. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: So investigation, not saying we've got a repair to do yet?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Exactly. I'll investigate the pressure drop first. Not committing to a repair when we don't know what's behind it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Davey owns the investigation on the booster pump. It matters but it's not urgent, understood.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And the chiller on three? We haven't covered that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, Jamie, can you run a function test on the chiller on three next Tuesday? That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Still next Tuesday, even with that priority?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, next Tuesday is the timing. But that's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Understood. I'll run a function test on the chiller on three next Tuesday, first priority.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Jamie. That's the production hold-up one, not a routine low-priority test.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Right, got you. Sorry, I spoke over the end there.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No worries. Quality bit before we finish.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Hannah, can you write up the near miss at the palletiser by end of day? Top priority please.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, that's ahead of the toolbox talk, then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Absolutely. The near miss write-up is top priority please, by end of day.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Understood. I'll write up the near miss at the palletiser by end of day. That comes first for me.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: On the risk assessment— sorry, were you finished?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, go on, Grace.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I'll update the risk assessment for work on the trucks this morning.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Grace. Risk assessment for work on the trucks, this morning.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yep, that's mine.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Think that's my bit covered. Just making sure the filter was heard as a completion, not another job.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Same with the dryer shutdown. Cancelled, not waiting in the queue.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, both clear. And the access blockers stay blocked; we're not pretending we've got windows.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Right, cheers. A surprisingly coffee-free meeting.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Don't remind us. Thanks, everyone. That's us.
